name: What hidden conditions most often surprise office build-out budgets?

mainEntity.name: What are the most common surprise issues that make office build-outs more expensive than expected?
mainEntity.text: What are the most common surprise issues that make office build-outs more expensive than expected?

acceptedAnswer.text: Budget surprises in office build-outs usually come from what cannot be fully seen during early walkthroughs. Old electrical systems may need upgrades to support modern loads. HVAC equipment may be undersized or improperly zoned. Fire sprinkler or alarm systems may need rework to match the new layout. In some buildings, concealed water damage, uneven concrete, or prior tenant modifications create more demolition and repair than expected. Older properties in Pasadena, Burbank, or Glendale can also present special retrofit challenges that do not show up in a simple tour. A preconstruction investigation, as-built review, and early site inspection by the contractor can reduce risk, but they do not eliminate it. Tenants should expect some unknowns and protect the budget with contingency and a clear change-order process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common surprises include outdated electrical panels, undersized HVAC, missing fire protection, uneven slabs, concealed water damage, asbestos or other hazardous materials, and code upgrades required during permitting. These issues often appear after demolition starts and can increase both cost and schedule.
